title: Verus over-scoped: test-first bead requires no exec/spec binding targets
description: Eight (8) Verus required lane decisions (VLD-002,010,018,026,034,042,050,058) demand exec/spec-bound Verus proofs for a bead whose primary deliverable is a test fixture corpus (crates/workspace_tests/tests/restate_storage_blackhat_fixture_corpus.rs). There are no new production implementation functions to bind Verus specs to. Verus is inappropriate for test-first beads.
remediation: Replan with verus=not_applicable for all seeds; cite test-first bead scope. Re-run proof-planner for state 4.

title: Flux over-scoped: test-first bead has no refinement annotations on production code
description: Seven (7) Flux required lane decisions (VLD-004,012,020,028,036,052,060) demand Flux refinement annotations on behavior-affecting Rust code. The bead delivers a test file and minimal implementation if red tests require it. There are no new production code paths to annotate with Flux refinements.
remediation: Replan with flux-rs=not_applicable for all seeds; cite test-first bead scope. Re-run proof-planner for state 4.

title: TLA+ over-scoped: no temporal protocol, retry, lease, lifecycle, distributed, or interleaving behavior exists
description: Five (5) TLA+ required lane decisions (VLD-025,033,041,049,057) for persistence/recovery lifecycle seeds. However, the bead is local deterministic synchronous test infrastructure (boundary-map.md:36-39). The temporal claims are observable through behavior test assertions, not TLA+ model checking. TLA+ is only valid for temporal/state-over-time claims and cannot substitute for Rust-local test evidence.
remediation: Replan with tla-plus=not_applicable for all seeds; the temporal behavior is observable through deterministic test assertions. Re-run proof-planner for state 4.

title: Kani over-scoped for integration-only seeds: bounded codec Kani is valuable but integration seeds lack bounded codec properties
description: Five (5) Kani required lane decisions for integration-only seeds (VLD-027,035,043,051,059) covering side-index parity, journal gaps, duplicate events, stale snapshots, and missing manifests. These seeds operate through public storage APIs (FjallJournal, events_for_run, etc.), not bounded codec decode. The bounded model checking value is minimal for integration-level fixture tests. Three codec-boundary Kani lanes (VLD-003,011,019) remain accepted as they target bounded panic-freedom and typed classification over encode/decode.
remediation: Replan with kani=not_applicable for integration seeds (PS-004 through PS-008); keep kani=required for codec-boundary seeds (PS-001 through PS-003). Re-run proof-planner for state 4.
